name: MIA Teknoloji AS
summary: MIA Teknoloji AS engages in the business of developing information infrastructure solutions for private and public organizations. The firm also offers technological products for authentication, security, transportation, payment, management, and digitalization needs. The company was founded by Ali Gökhan Beltekin, Ihsan Ünal, and Mehmet Cengiz Bagmanci on August 16, 2006 and is headquartered in Ankara, Turkey.
